name: sessions
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(StartedAt) AS week, sum(Commits) AS commits, sum(CostUsd) AS cost FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime} GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

name: prs
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(PrMergedAt) AS week, count() AS merged FROM pull_requests WHERE PrMergedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND PrMergedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime} GROUP BY week ORDER BY week
